title: Depressions
body:
Take a bath or a shower every night, be in a silent dark place and shout, "Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah,
Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah, Allah!" Then listen which message will come to you. It is a very simple way to make
a connection with your heavenly position. Try it! You can also say, "Oh my Lord, oh my Lord..." or, "Ya Rabbi,
ya Rabbi..." Also go and visit old people's homes, prisons, hospitals and mental institutions regularly.
